title: Bind P112 tetrad decoder to selected ports; no kappa change
body:
## Summary

This package binds the P112 tetrad-local masked decoder to the selected complex provider's 112 nine-bit ports. The explicit bijection preserves all 12,544 pairings and verifies 6,720 constrained entries; the 56 mapped terms have rank 2 and total copy charge 112.

A conditional two-sided rank-32 budget with 166 ideal complex children and two hypothetical unpaid coordinates gives an ideal complex κ cap of `0.0137876681081` at `a=1/99`. The inherited bit-side cap is `0.0319843333739`, so the joint ideal cap is complex-limited. This is a planning relaxation, not an achieved κ: the selected value remains `0.001672660197076918`.

## Scope and limits

Both one-unpaid controls fail. The two-unpaid endpoint contracts are assumptions, and the new terms have no source-bound dirty-input implementation, owner chronology, restoration/consumer invoice, or admitted supplier. This package does not establish a physical construction, changed endpoint contract, or selected-frontier update. A useful next step is to implement one eight-port tetrad block against the actual provider interface, then price the complete dirty-input path and verify both unpaid-coordinate contracts.

## Test plan

Replayed with Python 3.12:

```sh
python3.12 -I -B research/selected-p112-tetrad-rank32-route/verify.py
python3 scripts/research_package.py --package research/selected-p112-tetrad-rank32-route --check-only
python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/selected-p112-tetrad-rank32-route
```

The verifier reconstructs the selected word and P112 geometry, checks the port bijection over all 12,544 pairs, verifies the constrained entries and all 56 term ranks, and recomputes both interval-priced profiles. The one-unpaid controls fail.

## Sources and credit

Package: `research/selected-p112-tetrad-rank32-route/`; base commit `20ecf2891d80b5acf18d980b2164fb44ea7faa90`; exact source pins are in `SOURCES.json`.

Related work: [PR #3344](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3344) screens larger children and multiple unpaid coordinates; [PR #3567](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3567) screens a one-sided tetrad alphabet; [PR #3604](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3604) composes the selected basis through the centre cut. The cached overlap scan covered 394 open PRs and 2,319 discussions as of 2026-10-18 03:15 UTC; refresh failed, so it is not a novelty certificate. The P112 geometry and local identity retain the predecessor package's attribution; source archive, complex ceiling, centre ledger and bit pricing engine are pinned in this package. Prepared by Gonzalo Mier with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; Apache-2.0. No independent human review is claimed.
